name: Race Car
summary: Open-wheel single-seater race car with front and rear wings and a round number disc, in side view facing right.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the tyres stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 800 px wide and 250 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the car bounces (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the car faces left
